subject: Geopolitics
title: ASEAN: Consensus and Caution
description: Learn ASEAN: Consensus and Caution in one minute.

hook.text: Ten Southeast Asian nations agree on almost nothing — yet ASEAN has kept regional peace for over 50 years.

buildup.text: ASEAN operates by consensus. No nation is overruled. The process is slow but no member feels forced.

discovery.text: The ASEAN Way values non-interference. Don't criticize internal affairs. Diplomacy over confrontation always.

twist.text: Critics say ASEAN is toothless. Myanmar's coup produced only statements, no sanctions, and no intervention.

climax.text: Yet ASEAN's centrality keeps it relevant. China, the US, and Japan all court it as the hub of Asian diplomacy.

punchline.text: Soft power works when harder options scare everyone.

quiz.question: What is the ASEAN Way?
options: A trade agreement reducing tariffs across Southeast Asia
A principle of non-interference and consensus-based decisions
A military alliance between ASEAN and China
